_source: Static UI keys for the mobile resident new-repair-request form (route srv-new, pototype/mobile-screens.jsx MSrvNewReport L61-121). KEYS ONLY — never a translation. MIXED LAYERS: fields listed as dict below are stable ids read with t(); the rest are the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key, read with tp(). ZERO-MINT WHERE POSSIBLE: the six category tiles reuse the existing sales.service.cat* dict as their LABELS — catPlumbing=sales.service.catPlumbing 'ระบบประปา', catElectrical=sales.service.catElectrical 'ระบบไฟฟ้า', catPaint=sales.service.catPaint 'ทาสี', catWindowDoor=sales.service.catWindowDoor 'หน้าต่าง/ประตู', catAircon=sales.service.catAircon 'ระบบแอร์', catFloorTile=sales.service.catFloorTile 'พื้น/กระเบื้อง'. DISPLAY ONLY — the create writes NO category at all and the tiles ship honest-DISABLED, pending BLOCKERS.md B-292 question (1). CORRECTION: an earlier revision of this _source claimed these values are "ALSO the vocabulary the seed stores". That is FALSE for 2 of the 6. Programmatic 3-way set-diff, re-run this round — dict = ระบบประปา · ระบบไฟฟ้า · ทาสี · หน้าต่าง/ประตู · ระบบแอร์ · พื้น/กระเบื้อง; seed SERVICE_TICKETS (packages/db/src/seed/index.ts L727-735) = ระบบประปา · ระบบไฟฟ้า · ทาสี · หน้าต่าง (L730) · ระบบแอร์ · พื้น (L733); mobile prototype tiles (L63-64) = ประปา · ไฟฟ้า · ทาสี · ประตู-หน้าต่าง · แอร์ · พื้น/กระเบื้อง — three different sets whose only common value is 'ทาสี'. None is authoritative: the dict values are the legend of the prototype's category-mix CHART (sales-service.jsx L131-136), a card the merged web port omits as mock analytics with no wire, and no merged code reads the six keys; the seed values are 7 mock rows from the same prototype; and service_ticket.category is free text that the merged web create form fills from a plain <input> (sales-service.tsx L830). Writing any of the three from mobile would fork a column the register renders raw, so this port withholds the write and files the choice in BLOCKERS.md B-292. saved=labor.att.savedBadge 'บันทึกแล้ว' and failed=admin.common.actionFailedToast are the same honest write-outcome strings pm_checkin / pm_checklist / pm_notes borrowed (BLOCKERS.md B-268 ก). SIX values are net-new and staged in agents/orch-d-recon/service-group-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (docs/extract/i18n-full.json is UNTOUCHED by this slice): eyebrow 'ลูกบ้าน · แจ้งซ่อม' (L68), title 'แจ้งซ่อมใหม่' (L68), fieldUnit 'ยูนิตของฉัน' (L72), fieldCategory 'เลือกหมวด' (L75), fieldProblem 'คำอธิบายปัญหา' (L89), submit 'ส่งแจ้งซ่อม' (L114). Each was grepped out of the raw .jsx this round and is asserted byte-exact by test/screens/service/service_sidecar_test.dart; all six already resolve in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th) and light up en/zh/ar once applied. See BLOCKERS.md B-292. NOT REPRESENTED HERE — four prototype strings are DROPPED rather than keyed, because each names something the schema cannot store or the machine cannot do (BLOCKERS.md B-293): (1) 'รูปประกอบ (อย่างน้อย 1 รูป)' (L94) — service_ticket has NO photo column and this route has no upload seam, so the label plus its '+' tile would promise an attachment that is silently discarded, and the prototype marks it REQUIRED, a rule nothing here could honour; (2) 'นัดวันสะดวก' (L106) — there is no column meaning 'the slot the resident would like'; scheduled_date means 'the appointment that was set', so writing a wish into it would light the timeline's second step on srv-track and show a false appointment on tech-jobs; (3) 'บันทึกร่าง' (L112) — the machine's start state is `received` and it has no draft state at all (apps/api/src/routes/sales-service.ts L21-27); (4) the mock unit VALUE 'B-08 · juneflow ราชพฤกษ์ เฟส 2 (Warranty 11 เดือน)' (L73) is mock DATA, not a key — unit_id is a project_node uuid with no label endpoint, so the kept label renders over an em-dash (the merged web port em-dashes the same field). The mock problem sentence (L91) is likewise mock data: the box ships EMPTY for the resident to type.
